title: Compliance Timeline Harvester & Proof Redaction Workflow
creator: Ayesha Patel
description:
Summary: Build a 'Timeline Harvester' that assembles time-ordered evidence manifests for jurisdictional residency and retention audits, plus an automated Proof Redaction Workflow that strips or masks PII before packaging artifacts for external auditors. This ticket covers the PM scope: acceptance criteria, product UX patterns, rollout plan, stakeholder comms, and success metrics. Engineering scope (impl work items) will be tracked as ENG sub-tasks.

Background: Customers pursuing SOC 2 and ISO 27001 frequently need: (1) compact, time-bounded bundles of artifacts that prove a control was in place at a specific time window; (2) the ability to demonstrate retention behaviors over time (deletion/archival actions); and (3) an auditable chain-of-custody for proofs without leaking customer PII. Existing evidence collectors produce raw artifacts but lack a single time-series view, standardized manifests, and redaction controls that are safe for auditor delivery.

Goals:
- Produce an evidence manifest format (lightweight JSON lines) that lists ordered artifacts, their provenance (collector id, region, timestamp), retention status, and cryptographic digest.
- Implement a 'harvest' operation that can produce: point-in-time bundles, sliding-window bundles, and retention-change deltas.
- Provide a configurable Redaction Pipeline that supports pattern redaction, schema-aware maskers (for JSON logs), and an optional KMS-backed stamp indicating redaction was applied by Redwood (signed assertion).
- UI: Console view called 'Compliance Timeline' to visualize timeline bundles, filter by region/control, preview redaction diffs, and request auditor-ready bundles.
- Compliance runbook integration: one-click generation of SOC 2 / ISO artifact pack with checksums, control mapping, and a human-readable summary.

Non-goals:
- This ticket does NOT rework audit logging collection agents; assumes existing collectors (config-snapshotter, access-log-archiver) emit standardized artifact metadata.
- Does not include full legal attestation language or billing model changes.
acceptance_criteria: Standardized evidence manifest schema published in product docs (doc link in attachments)
Harvester endpoint in the control plane that returns bundles for a requested time window (examples in comments)
Redaction pipeline available as an opt-in step that produces auditor-ready artifacts and a redaction log
Console: Compliance Timeline view that lists bundles with provenance, region, retention state, and a download action
Automated test harness that replays 30 days of synthetic events and validates retention deltas and manifest digests
success_metrics: Time-to-generate auditor bundle <= 3 minutes for typical 7-day window (50GB of artifacts), reduction in manual evidence prep tickets by 80% within 3 months of rollout, positive customer NPS feedback in compliance pilot (target >= 8/10).
tradeoffs_and_decisions: Prefer server-side deterministic redaction with KMS stamping to avoid shipping raw PII to auditors. This increases compute and KMS usage per bundle but yields stronger audit guarantees. We will initially support JSON and plaintext artifacts; binary/attachment redaction will be handled by returning a redaction wrapper pointing to original S3/GCS object (read-only) to avoid costly binary processing in v1.
rollout_plan: 1) Pilot with 3 enterprise customers (invite-only) and SOC 2 consulting partner; 2) Gather feedback and iterate on redaction rules; 3) GA to all Dedicated and Hosted accounts with feature flag; 4) Private deployment docs for on-prem config and KMS integration.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: accidental PII leakage in early redaction rules. Mitigation: require security review and run automated leak detection tests on every generated bundle; pilot customers must opt-in. Risk: large bundles affecting latency. Mitigation: support streamed bundle exports and precompute manifests during off-peak windows.
implementation_notes: Engineers to implement: harvest API (/v1/compliance/harvest), manifest schema v1 (manifest-v1), redaction pipeline as pluggable steps (pattern masker, json-schema masker, custom regex), and KMS sign endpoint for proof stamping. Add metrics: bundle_generation_time, redaction_errors, manifest_digest_mismatch. Add RBAC checks: only accounts with compliance:generate permission may download auditor bundles.
acceptance_testing_instructions: Use the synthetic dataset in attachments for replay. Run the harvester for date range 2025-09-01 to 2025-09-07 and validate the returned manifest has 7 daily snapshots, each with digest and region tag. Confirm redaction pipeline removes emails and replaces with <REDACTED_EMAIL> and that the signed-redaction assertion verify endpoint returns true.
acceptance_criteria_notes: Updated_at >= created_at enforced. Ensure compliance with privacy and retention policies in regional laws (EU, CA).
